registryEntry.label: Deploy Windows Time Synchronisation (NTP) Settings Catalog Policy
registryEntry.get_command: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/beta/deviceManagement/configurationPolicies?$expand=settings,assignments').value | ForEach-Object { $p = $_; $si = @($p.settings | ForEach-Object { $_.settingInstance }); $cfg = @($si | Where-Object { $_.settingDefinitionId -eq 'device_vendor_msft_policy_config_admx_w32time_w32time_policy_configure_ntpclient' })[0]; $kids = @($cfg.choiceSettingValue.children); [pscustomobject]@{ id = $p.id; name = $p.name; platforms = $p.platforms; ntpClientEnabled = (@($si | Where-Object { $_.settingDefinitionId -eq 'device_vendor_msft_policy_config_admx_w32time_w32time_policy_enable_ntpclient' -and $_.choiceSettingValue.value -eq 'device_vendor_msft_policy_config_admx_w32time_w32time_policy_enable_ntpclient_1' }).Count -gt 0); ntpConfigured = ($cfg.choiceSettingValue.value -eq 'device_vendor_msft_policy_config_admx_w32time_w32time_policy_configure_ntpclient_1'); timeServer = @($kids | Where-Object { $_.settingDefinitionId -like '*_ntpserver' })[0].simpleSettingValue.value; ntpType = (@($kids | Where-Object { $_.settingDefinitionId -like '*_type' })[0].choiceSettingValue.value -replace '^.*_type_', ''); pollInterval = @($kids | Where-Object { $_.settingDefinitionId -like '*_specialpollinterval' })[0].simpleSettingValue.value; assignments = @($p.assignments) } } | Where-Object { ($_.name -eq 'CMMC-Time-Sync') -or (($_.platforms -eq 'windows10') -and ($_.ntpClientEnabled -eq $true) -and ($_.ntpConfigured -eq $true) -and (@($_.timeServer | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0) -and ($_.ntpType -eq 'ntp') -and ($null -ne $_.pollInterval -and [double]$_.pollInterval -ge 1) -and ($null -ne $_.pollInterval -and [double]$_.pollInterval -le 3600) -and (@($_.assignments | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0)) } | Sort-Object { $_.name -ne 'CMMC-Time-Sync' } | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
